request.query: Coefficient bound for diagonal substitution P(X,...,X) by support cardinality times uniform coefficient bound

items.name: MvPowerSeries.constantCoeff_subst
items.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_3} [inst : CommRing R] {τ : Type u_4} {S : Type u_5} [inst_1 : CommRing S]
  [inst_2 : Algebra R S] {a : σ → MvPowerSeries τ S},
  MvPowerSeries.HasSubst a →
    ∀ (f : MvPowerSeries σ R),
      MvPowerSeries.constantCoeff (MvPowerSeries.subst a f) =
        ∑ᶠ (d : σ →₀ ℕ), (MvPowerSeries.coeff d) f • MvPowerSeries.constantCoeff (d.prod fun s e => a s ^ e)

items.name: MvPowerSeries.coeff_subst
items.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_3} [inst : CommRing R] {τ : Type u_4} {S : Type u_5} [inst_1 : CommRing S]
  [inst_2 : Algebra R S] {a : σ → MvPowerSeries τ S},
  MvPowerSeries.HasSubst a →
    ∀ (f : MvPowerSeries σ R) (e : τ →₀ ℕ),
      (MvPowerSeries.coeff e) (MvPowerSeries.subst a f) =
        ∑ᶠ (d : σ →₀ ℕ), (MvPowerSeries.coeff d) f • (MvPowerSeries.coeff e) (d.prod fun s e => a s ^ e)

items.name: PowerSeries.coeff_subst'
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommRing R] {S : Type u_4} [inst_1 : CommRing S] [inst_2 : Algebra R S] {b : PowerSeries S},
  PowerSeries.HasSubst b →
    ∀ (f : PowerSeries R) (e : ℕ),
      (PowerSeries.coeff e) (PowerSeries.subst b f) =
        ∑ᶠ (d : ℕ), (PowerSeries.coeff d) f • (PowerSeries.coeff e) (b ^ d)

items.name: Polynomial.coeff_le_of_roots_le
items.type:
∀ {F : Type u_3} {K : Type u_4} [inst : CommRing F] [inst_1 : NormedField K] {p : Polynomial F} {f : F →+* K} {B : ℝ}
  (i : ℕ),
  p.Monic →
    (Polynomial.map f p).Splits →
      (∀ z ∈ (Polynomial.map f p).roots, ‖z‖ ≤ B) →
        ‖(Polynomial.map f p).coeff i‖ ≤ B ^ (p.natDegree - i) * ↑(p.natDegree.choose i)

items.name: PowerSeries.coeff_subst
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommRing R] {τ : Type u_3} {S : Type u_4} [inst_1 : CommRing S] [inst_2 : Algebra R S]
  {a : MvPowerSeries τ S},
  PowerSeries.HasSubst a →
    ∀ (f : PowerSeries R) (e : τ →₀ ℕ),
      (MvPowerSeries.coeff e) (PowerSeries.subst a f) =
        ∑ᶠ (d : ℕ), (PowerSeries.coeff d) f • (MvPowerSeries.coeff e) (a ^ d)
